ig-DXsns8PpVlj.name: Dating After 25 — Setup-Punchline Meme
ig-DXsns8PpVlj.tagline: Persistent top caption establishes a relatable scenario; an iMessage exchange frames a dramatic claim; a Vine boom + immediate contradictory action delivers the punchline.

files.source.mp4: Original IG reel — 1080x1920, 11s. Don't pass as reference_videos for remixes (the photoreal human in it trips Seedance E005). Used for analysis and reference only.
files.format.json: Gemini structural analysis. Read `beats[]`, `audio_design.key_sfx[]`, `remixable.swappable[]` / `fixed[]`, and `remix_template` before designing a remix. The `remix_template` field is the load-bearing scaffold.
files.overlays/overlay_healthy_lifestyle.png: Example overlay PNG for the healthy-lifestyle remix — header text + iMessage bubbles. Reference for the overlay-pre-render pattern; future remixes generate their own overlays.

load_bearing_structure: Persistent top-center caption establishing the scenario, full duration
Beat 2 (1.5–4.5s): outgoing iMessage reply bubbles with a dramatic claim
Beat 3 (4.5–end): Vine boom + immediate physical action that contradicts the claim
swappable: The text in each iMessage bubble (the lie and the prompt)

notes: Format packs are pulled from GCS, not committed.
Format packs share the GCS prefix `style-packs/` with style packs — a pack can have `format.json` and/or `style.json` and be used in either workflow.
Path references in docs/format-rip/examples/*.json assume the pack is pulled to runs/style-packs/<slug>/.

To add a new format pack: follow the workflow in docs/format-rip/README.md, then push with `python scripts/asset_pack_push.py runs/style-packs/<slug> <slug> --prefix style-packs`, then add an entry here.
